title: Giants’ Dominic Zvada impresses John Harbaugh in preseason debut

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants’ Dominic Zvada impresses John Harbaugh in preseason debut
sources.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh praised rookie kicker Dominic Zvada after he hit 43- and 38-yard field goals in a 26-3 preseason win over the Dolphins.
